Donations are tax deductible and we need your support to continue our work. Text-to-donate, text VSRF to 53-555.Show more This week, VSRF Live is on the road to Austin, Texas! We’re joining our friends and allies at Children’s Health Defense’s “Moment of Truth” Conference, and while in town, we’re broadcasting LIVE from The HighWire studio for a very special behind-the-scenes episode.
Joining us is the fabulous Jenn Sherry Parry — an Emmy Award–winning Executive Producer and DGA Director with more than two decades in network television. Beginning her career at E! Entertainment Television, Jenn went on to produce live events, documentaries, and major network programs, spending ten years at CBS’s The Doctors where her groundbreaking medical storytelling and international reporting earned her a 2010 Emmy Award.
In 2018, Jenn made a bold move — walking away from the corporate script to join Del Bigtree at The HighWire as Executive Producer. Since then, she’s helped to transform the show into one of the most fearless and dynamic programs in independent media. Known for her creative precision, warmth, and journalistic integrity, Jenn brings a passion for truth in storytelling and a deep commitment to elevating journalism that informs, heals, and protects future generations.
Jenn also produced our monumental Defeat the Mandates rallies in Washington, DC and Los Angeles — unforgettable moments of unity, courage, and truth. She’s the woman behind the camera calling the shots, and she is truly amazing at what she does.
This Thursday, Jenn joins Steve Kirsch and Livio Sanchez live from The HighWire control room to take us inside what it really takes to build a newsroom grounded in transparency and informed consent. Together, they’ll explore how legacy television shaped — and censored — public-health narratives, the editorial courage behind every viral HighWire segment, and why independent voices are now the last line of defense for medical freedom.
It’s an inside look at the heart of independent media, and a rare, inspiring conversation about the power of storytelling to change hearts, minds, and history.
Join us LIVE from Jenn’s studio for a rare, behind-the-scenes conversation about truth, media, and the power of storytelling to change hearts, minds, and history.
📅 Thursday, November 6
🕕 7 PM Eastern / 4 PM Pacific
